sample_scenarios.title: E-Commerce User Checkout & Coupon Flow
sample_scenarios.story: As an authenticated shopper, when I add items to my cart and apply a 20% discount coupon code 'SUMMER20', the cart total should update automatically. When I proceed to payment with a valid credit card, the order should complete, redirect to confirmation page with an order ID, and trigger an email confirmation.
